name: Data engineer
goal: Build and maintain reliable data pipelines.
questions: Where are incoming records validated?
What happens when a source contract changes?
How can I tell why a transformation produced an unexpected result?
Which components would I change to support a new source?

name: Analytics engineer or analyst
questions: How is this report calculated?
Can I save the query and reuse it?
Can two reports produce conflicting values?
Can I trace a result back to its calculation?

name: Operations or business stakeholder
questions: Which metrics changed unexpectedly?
Can a finding be delivered automatically?
What evidence supports this alert?
Did the scheduled analysis complete?

name: ML engineer
goal: Build useful analyses without losing control of data quality and operations.
questions: What data does an analysis consume?
Which algorithm produced a result?
How is performance evaluated?
How is a model-generated explanation distinguished from a verified result?

name: Data or platform architect
questions: Where is the authoritative data stored?
Why is this a separate boundary?
What would change at higher volume?
Where are authorization and data-quality controls enforced?

name: Technical leader or executive
goal: Understand business value, risk and investment.
questions: What problem does this solve?
What is implemented today?
What evidence shows correctness?
What would productionizing for a regulated enterprise require?
